findings.body: The documented call at backend.md:66 passes `{ message, context, correlationId }` as the first argument. This implementation serializes that entire object under `message`, leaving the top-level `context` empty and omitting `module`. Consequently, following the example violates the logging contract in standards.md:158–161: message is not fixed text and details are unavailable under `context`. Normalize structured inputs into the required fields, or change the logger signature and example together.
